lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular matrix of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters positioned posterior to the branchial region, organized into approximately five discernible horizontal rows that increase in inter-blob spacing towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Discrete vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like configuration of anchor nodes across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple linear features oriented horizontally along the dorsal-lateral interface, defined by a sharp transition from high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side to low-intensity shadow pixels on the ventral side, indicating at least three distinct structural ridges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of high-luminance circular pixel groups is clearly visible within the boundaries of the first dorsal fin silhouette, primarily concentrated in the anterior and medial zones of the fin's surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with remoras positioned in the sub-pectoral and ventral regions.
